config.fairness_rule: One selected project per town in the participation case; not a social-equity guarantee
config.cost_scope: One-time capital only; unknown annual operating costs remain blank and are not assumed zero
config.coverage_rule: One mutually exclusive package per town; covered municipal paved road groups are disjoint by town
config.limitation: No verified lane-km, event-level salt logs, vendor prices, installed capacity, hydrologic response or shared-equipment dispatch
